briefing.focus: Push the Nomad hostel proposal forward — the single item that genuinely moves the business.
briefing.text: Morning, Zac. Quick portfolio housekeeping: your Vanguard five hundred is sold and out of the book, and you've put twelve and a half thousand into AdraCard on the SAFE note — that one's private and illiquid, so it sits on the watchlist for news rather than a live price. What's left in the market is WiseTech and ServiceNow, worth about thirty-two and a half thousand together, down roughly three thousand four hundred overall. WiseTech's still the drag, off about fifteen percent against your cost, while ServiceNow's up near six. On the watchlist, Bapcor's the mover, down sharply, while CSL and Telix each slipped a couple of percent and Woodside ticked up. Prices here are last-known from late June — the next full briefing will refresh them. If you do one thing today, push the Nomad proposal forward. It's the single thing that actually moves the business.
